feedback: Approved unchanged. This is the final iteration, so the candidate is judged on whether it is the strongest design available for the unseen track, not on whether it is ideal. The candidate is the iteration-10 design: wheel_track 0.10, base_speed 0.9, kd 0.3, ki 0.4, kp 2.0, search_right, sensor y 0.05, x -0.07 to 0.07, sensor_size 0.016. Evidence: iteration 10 (95.95) is the only raced design with zero line-loss events on every development track. It also has the highest mean progress on all three tracks: oval 0.390 (iteration 9: 0.373), s-bend 0.178 (0.160), slalom 0.110 (0.101). Iteration 9 (98.24, wheel_track 0.14) scored higher only because of one lucky oval finish out of 20 trials, and its slalom line loss returned at 0.6 per trial. max_error stayed at 0.060 to 0.065 across iterations 0 to 10, so no change in this line of tuning has cleared the off-track limit on development tracks. With no iteration left, an untested revision, such as base_speed 1.0 or sensor_size 0.012, would race for the first time on the unseen track and could lose the line, so I am not asking for one. Judge the result by line_loss_events, progress and max_error per track, and by completion_time if the unseen track is gentle enough to finish.
requested_changes: Race the iteration-10 design unchanged. Its zero line loss and highest progress on all three development tracks are the best-supported evidence, and an untested revision in the final iteration carries too much risk.
